# WordPress.com

Manage WordPress.com and Jetpack-connected sites, content, media, comments, Reader data, statistics, and supported platform features through the centralized WordPress.com API.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/wordpress-com/.

## Actions

- **Create Draft Post**: Create a non-public draft post on an authorized site.
- **Delete Draft Post**: Permanently delete an existing draft post after verifying it is still a draft.
- **Get Post** (read-only): Get one post by ID in editable context, including raw content and its current status.
- **Get Site Overview** (read-only): Get concise identity, plan, capabilities, editable settings, and traffic summary for one authorized site.
- **List Blogging Prompts** (read-only): List WordPress.com writing prompts for a site, optionally filtered by date or text, with agent-controlled pagination.
- **List CMS Resources** (read-only): List categories, tags, comments, media, or users for an authorized site through one consistent paginated read tool.
- **List Content** (read-only): List and search editable posts or pages on an authorized site, including drafts, with compact raw and rendered content fields and…
- **List Reader Subscriptions** (read-only): List feeds and sites followed by the connected WordPress.com account without changing subscriptions.
- **List Sites** (read-only): List every WordPress.com or Jetpack-connected site authorized by the global OAuth account, returning stable numeric site IDs and concise…
- **Update Draft Post**: Update title, body, excerpt, taxonomy, featured media, or comment policy for an existing draft.
